scoreScale.2: implemented locally or conventional platform capability

topologyClasses.1: gauge-invariant loop phase or geometric holonomy, continuously tunable and not a protected Z3 sector
topologyClasses.2: discrete Z3 sector protected against local deformation within a declared gap and superselection regime

platforms.name: Passive switched two-port circuit
platforms.currentBoundary: Three switch settings are labels; the rank-three response is deliberately engineered and is not holonomy evidence.
platforms.nextGate: Run the supplied nodal-conductance fixture, then reproduce it in SPICE or on a resistor-switch bench with fixed ports.

platforms.name: Topolectrical or microwave phase ring
platforms.currentBoundary: The product of directed link phases around a closed ring is a real synthetic holonomy, but selecting phases 0, 2pi/3 and 4pi/3 does not make the continuously tunable U(1) loop a protected Z3 theory.
platforms.nextGate: Simulate a passive or passively dilated ring at three loop phases and require the signal to disappear when the loop is cut.

platforms.name: Conventional Josephson or SQUID loop
platforms.currentBoundary: Flux bias gives a physical U(1) loop holonomy and standard microwave ports, but three flux biases are not protected Z3 superselection sectors.
platforms.nextGate: Model the Hermitian dissipative part of the same two-port admittance at fluxes 0, Phi0/3 and 2Phi0/3 with loop-open and sweep-reversal controls.

platforms.name: Planckian t-J two-current transport
platforms.currentBoundary: The positive particle-energy spectral matrix is exact in principle, but the physical lattice energy current is not implemented; three twisted boundary phases are U(1) flux samples rather than Z3 topological sectors.
platforms.nextGate: Derive and validate the physical energy current before adding common twisted-boundary sectors to the same FTLM samples.

platforms.name: Outcome Dynamics GaAs electromechanics
platforms.currentBoundary: Charge and optical displacement are established readouts but are not entries of one positive response matrix; the consistent-versus-lumped mass disagreement leaves the numerical gate open.
platforms.nextGate: Close lateral/support refinement and define two conjugate drive-response ports whose dissipative Gram matrix is positive before introducing three boundary labels.

platforms.name: Z3 parafermion or discrete-gauge Josephson platform
platforms.currentBoundary: This is the only candidate with the right protected discrete-sector semantics, but sector preparation, lifetime, fixed two-port response and false-positive controls are not established inside the programme.
platforms.nextGate: Treat as a long-horizon target until a microscopic Hamiltonian, gap, sector-changing operators, preparation protocol and response readout are all explicit.
